core_obligations: Take a finite type point x and represent it by a locally finite type Spec(k) -> X (proof lines 5099-5101).
Use permanence under composition to see that the composite with f is locally of finite type (proof lines 5101-5102).
Conclude that f(x) is a finite type point of Y (proof lines 5102-5103).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally of finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, the image of the finite type points of X is contained in the finite type points of Y (source lines 5091-5097). The proof represents a finite type point x by a locally finite type morphism Spec(k) -> X and observes that the composite with f is again locally of finite type by permanence of local finite typeness under composition, which is exactly the definition of f(x) being a finite type point.
